verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a scrape endpoint that turns a URL into parseable text, and claims it can extract data from 'complicated websites'. Nothing in the evidence mentions JavaScript execution, headless-browser rendering of single-page applications, or returning fully rendered HTML; the documented output is text, not HTML. Scraping is an adjacent capability and does not establish JS rendering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can render JavaScript-heavy single-page applications and get the fully rendered HTML
